solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Is hotel involved in chart error?

indicators.note: something involved in another is wrapped up inside it, so the first pieces sit within the map

parts.note: a chart is a map
H is Hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A navigator spots a slip: the hotel has been marked in the wrong place on the chart.
explanation.definitionFit: A mishap is an unlucky accident or slip, so it can stand for an error.

clue.text: Pitman inspires awe as a capturer of thoughts?

indicators.note: inspires is read as breathes in, taking the second piece inside

parts.note: a pitman is a coal miner
dread is fear, akin to awe

explanation.surface: A mine worker is amazed by someone who seems to know what everyone thinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspires' looks like 'motivates' but here means taking in.
explanation.definitionFit: A mind-reader claims to perceive others' unspoken ideas, playfully a catcher of them.

clue.text: Weapon a Parisian dropped being pierced

indicators.note: the French a is dropped from the weapon's name

parts.note: a stun gun is an electric weapon
un is French for a, as a Parisian would say

explanation.surface: A Frenchman drops his gun after being stabbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Stung describes having been pricked by a sting, as by a wasp.

clue.text: Body of water in addition almost filling region

indicators.note: the shortened word fills the inside of the region

parts.note: an area is a region

indicators.note: almost removes the last letter of the word

parts.note: also means in addition

explanation.surface: A geographical description: a lake that nearly fills a whole region.
explanation.definitionFit: The Aral Sea is a shrinking lake in Central Asia, between Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.

clue.text: Illogical argument against getting married?

parts.note: a con is an argument against, as in pros and cons
fused means joined together, playfully read as wedded

explanation.surface: Someone argues irrationally against tying the knot.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags 'getting married' as a whimsical stretch: two things fused are joined as one.
explanation.definitionFit: Confused reasoning is muddled and incoherent, hence lacking logic.

clue.text: Unusual uproar after loss of silver

indicators.note: the uproar word suffers the loss of the chemical symbol for silver

parts.note: outrage is a public uproar
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A strange outcry follows a theft of silverware.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking AG from OUTRAGE leaves OUTRE.
explanation.definitionFit: Outré means unconventional or bizarre, beyond normal bounds.

clue.text: One very particular about things in song and dance fund

parts.note: a song and dance is a fuss
a pot is a fund of money, as in a kitty

explanation.surface: A picky person cares about the details of a performance fund.
explanation.definitionFit: A fusspot is someone fastidious who frets over small details.

clue.text: Ship carrying pale blue soft material

indicators.note: the ship carries the pale word inside it

parts.note: SS is steamship
wan means pale
down means low in spirits, blue

explanation.surface: A vessel transports a cargo of pale blue fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Swansdown is the fine soft feathers of a swan, or a soft fabric resembling them.

clue.text: Information a little upsetting

indicators.note: in a down clue upsetting turns the pieces upside down, reading them backwards

parts.note: a tad is a little

explanation.surface: Some news is mildly distressing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upsetting' looks like an adjective but turns 'a TAD' upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Data are facts and figures, that is, information.

clue.text: They sense poet's beheaded after capturing old Queen in revolutionary way

indicators.note: the trimmed poet captures the turned name, holding it inside
beheaded removes the poet's first letter

parts.note: Dante is the Italian poet; the 's means is

indicators.note: revolutionary means turned round, so the queen's name is read backwards

parts.note: Anne was a queen of Great Britain, 1702-1714

explanation.surface: A grisly tale of a poet beheaded in a revolution after seizing a queen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' suggests the French Revolution's guillotine, but it only signals turning the queen's name round; 'after capturing' means the trimmed poet holds it.
explanation.definitionFit: Antennae are feelers with which insects detect their surroundings.

clue.text: Time to abandon unbiased and clear computer system

indicators.note: Time is told to abandon the word for unbiased, so its letter leaves it

parts.note: unbiased means neutral
net means clear, as in clear profit after deductions

explanation.surface: It is time to stop being impartial and make the case plain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to abandon' takes the T out of NEUTRAL, leaving NEURAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A neural net is a computing architecture modelled loosely on brain cells, used in machine learning.

clue.text: Spar joining front half of ship to rear

indicators.note: the front half of the four-letter word ship is its first two letters

parts.note: aft means the rear part of a vessel

explanation.surface: A boat's spar runs from the bow section to the stern.
explanation.definitionFit: A spar is a pole or long rod, and a shaft is a similar long straight stick.

clue.text: Sent material made an impression with staff

parts.note: something that registered made an impression or sank in
a post is a staff or pole

explanation.surface: A shipment arrives, and some employee clearly made an impression on the team.
explanation.definitionFit: Registered post is a postal service for valuable mail, so it is a kind of material sent.

clue.text: Well-off, linking those people to individual in one US city

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: the linked pieces go in the city abbreviation

parts.note: NY is New York
them refers to those people
one means an individual

explanation.surface: A wealthy person is connected to one prominent figure in an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: In the money is an idiom for being rich or prosperous.

clue.text: Expression of surprise about recording getting top position?

indicators.note: the exclamation goes about, or around, the recording

parts.note: aha is an exclamation of surprise or discovery
an LP is a long-playing record

explanation.surface: Someone gasps on learning that their record has reached number one in the charts.
explanation.definitionFit: Alpha is the first Greek letter, so it denotes the leading place, as in the alpha male.

clue.text: Photograph capturing an island in it, being especially good at keys?

indicators.note: the photograph captures the following pieces, holding them inside

parts.note: pic is short for picture

indicators.note: an and the island abbreviation go in the word it

explanation.surface: A snapshot of an island on which someone excels at keyboards.
explanation.walkthrough: Two containers nest here: 'in it' wraps the island pair first, and that unit is what the photograph captures.
explanation.definitionFit: Pianistic means skilled at or suited to the piano, an instrument played with keys.

clue.text: Something worn for going out, good in nearby shopping centre

parts.note: nigh means near

indicators.note: the letter for good is placed in the word for the shopping centre

parts.note: town, in British use, is the shopping area of a place, as in going into town

explanation.surface: Choosing a smart outfit to wear for a trip to the local shops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going out' means dropping off to sleep, not an evening out.
explanation.definitionFit: A nightgown is a garment worn in bed, so it is worn while one goes out, that is, falls asleep.

clue.text: Satellite many misinterpreted to have jagged edge all round

indicators.note: the jumbled edge goes all round the jumbled many
jagged means broken and irregular, so these letters are rearranged
misinterpreted means read wrongly, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A moon whose rough rim is misread by many observers.
explanation.walkthrough: Both halves are anagrams: 'misinterpreted' works on many, 'jagged' on edge, and 'all round' says which goes outside.
explanation.definitionFit: Ganymede is Jupiter's largest moon, a natural satellite.

clue.text: End of serenade — wordless singing — my German is a battle

indicators.note: the end of serenade is its final letter

parts.note: la-la is singing without words
mein is German for my

explanation.surface: A musical performance ends with humming, and a German speaker claims it as a fight.
explanation.definitionFit: El Alamein in Egypt was the site of decisive Second World War battles in 1942.

clue.text: Inability to talk quietly, interrupting exclamation over continent

indicators.note: in a down clue the exclamation sits over the continent
the quiet letter interrupts the combined pieces, sitting inside them

parts.note: ah is an exclamation
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly
Asia is a continent

explanation.surface: Someone stunned into silence, softly gasping across Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Aphasia is a disorder, often after a stroke, that impairs the use of language.

clue.text: Second, then less specific date reference

parts.note: mo is a short time, a second, as in 'half a mo'
nth denotes an unspecified item in a sequence, so it is less precise

explanation.surface: Someone narrows a date down vaguely: one moment, then a looser reference.
explanation.definitionFit: A date is given by day, month and year, so a month is one of its reference parts.

clue.text: American I caught in bad French show

indicators.note: the pieces go in the French word for bad

parts.note: mal is French for bad
US is American
c is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: An American gets caught performing in a terrible French production.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical is a stage production with songs, a kind of theatrical show.

clue.text: Mike expert initially modifies: hearing OK now?

parts.note: Mike is a short form of Michael
a master is an expert

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of modifies

explanation.surface: Someone asks if their hearing aid, tweaked by a specialist called Mike, now works.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hearing' is a court hearing, not the sense: law sittings occur in this autumn session.
explanation.definitionFit: Michaelmas term is the autumn sitting of English law courts, a time when cases are heard.

clue.text: Support a bit of leisure — after relaxation

indicators.note: the bit comes after the relaxation word

parts.note: ease is relaxation

indicators.note: a bit of leisure is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone backs a little free time after a period of rest.
explanation.definitionFit: An easel is a stand that holds up a painting or board.

clue.text: US-born poet upset John? Not entirely

indicators.note: in a down clue upset turns the trimmed word upside down, reading it backwards
not entirely means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: john is American slang for a lavatory

explanation.surface: An American-born writer is somewhat put out by someone named John.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not entirely' trims TOILET to TOILE; 'upset' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: T. S. Eliot was born in St Louis, Missouri, before settling in England.

clue.text: Promotes eradicating source of Government benefit

indicators.note: eradicating means wiping out, so the letter is removed

parts.note: plugs means promotes, as in advertising

indicators.note: the source of Government is its first letter

explanation.surface: Political promotion cuts off funding from the state.
explanation.definitionFit: A plus is an advantage or asset, a benefit.

clue.text: Flower: item for sale by our group

parts.note: a lot is an item put up at auction
us means our group of people

explanation.surface: An auction catalogue lists a bloom put up by the gardening club.
explanation.definitionFit: The lotus is a water lily, a flowering plant.

clue.text: Corruption? Small decrease after leader's deposed

indicators.note: the trimmed word comes after the letter for small
the leader of the word for decrease is removed, so its first letter goes

parts.note: a reduction is a decrease

explanation.surface: A political scandal? A minor slide follows the head of state being overthrown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leader's deposed' takes R off REDUCTION, leaving EDUCTION.
explanation.definitionFit: Seduction is leading someone astray, a moral corrupting, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Friendly lad displacing new guy to embrace one

indicators.note: the following pieces displace, or replace, the letter for new in the word for lad

parts.note: a lad is a son

indicators.note: the word for guy surrounds, or embraces, the letter for one

parts.note: a guy is a rope or cable bracing a tent or mast
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An affable boy pushes a newcomer aside so he can hug someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guy' is the rope sense, not a man; 'displacing' means the whole embraced unit takes the place of the letter for new.
explanation.definitionFit: Sociable describes someone who enjoys company and is warm to others.

clue.text: Be very critical of accepting odd bits of talk, brooking no argument

indicators.note: the word for criticise accepts, or takes in, the picked letters

parts.note: to flay is to criticise savagely

indicators.note: odd bits are the first and third letters of talk

explanation.surface: A harsh critic hears snatches of conversation and allows no dissent.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something flatly means saying it bluntly and without room for dispute.
